⌘K / Ctrl+K · 感知当前筛选与勾选项: ⌘K / Ctrl+K · Uses the current filters and selection
从原始意图追踪到计划、审批、实际修改与回滚，区分页面操作、AI、MCP 和系统任: Trace the original intent through plans, approvals, changes and rollbacks, across the UI, AI, MCP and scheduled tasks.
会话保存在 Redis；计划与实际变更独立保留，过期会话不会抹去审批和变更记录。: Sessions are stored in Redis. Plans and changes are retained independently, so session expiry does not erase approval or change history.
会话内容和查询到的业务数据会发送给你配置的模型服务商。写操作会先展示计划与差异，: Session content and queried business data are sent to your configured model provider. Writes show a plan and diff before you confirm execution.
关联计划暂时无法加载: The linked plan could not be loaded
审计参数与结果已在后端脱敏；凭证和密码不会作为审计详情返回。: Audit inputs and results are redacted on the server. Credentials and passwords are excluded from audit details.
已获取最新预览，请检查差异后确认: Latest preview loaded. Review the changes before confirming.
当前会话正在生成，可先停止再发送新消息: This session is generating a response. Stop it before sending another message.
当前数据或计划有效期已变化，重新预演并确认新差异后才可继续。: The data or plan validity has changed. Preview again and confirm the new diff to continue.
当前账号没有 AI 使用权限: This account does not have AI access
当前账号没有使用 AI 的权限: This account does not have AI access
描述你的意图，例如：把选中的用户停用: Describe your intent, for example: disable the selected users
数据或有效期已变化，请重新预演并确认: The data or validity period has changed. Preview and confirm again.
正在恢复会话，完成后可以发送此消息: Restoring this session. You can send this message when it is ready.
此步骤已执行，请检查下一步的实际预览再确认: Step applied. Review the actual preview of the next step before confirming.
此计划依赖前一步的执行结果，需要逐步检查与确认。: This plan depends on the preceding write result. Review and confirm each step.
此计划超出 AI 的执行上限。请检查差异，并使用每步下方的入口前往管理页面。: This plan exceeds the AI execution limit. Review the diff and follow each step’s link to its management page.
确认删除会话？计划与变更记录会保留。: Delete this session? Plans and change records will be retained.
计划不存在或当前账号无法访问: The plan does not exist or is inaccessible to this account
请在模型服务中配置并测试支持工具调用的模型后使用 AI。: Configure and test a model that supports tool calls in Model providers before using AI.
输入意图，例如：把选中的用户停用（Shift+Enter 换行）: Enter your intent, for example: disable the selected users (Shift+Enter for a new line)
已发送审批申请，对方批准后由你执行: Approval requested. You can apply the plan after the reviewer approves it.
已按他人审批执行计划: Plan applied with another person’s approval
撤销审批并改为本人确认？: Revoke approval and return to self confirmation?
撤销后必须重新预演，才能本人确认或再次申请他人审批。: After revocation, preview again before confirming yourself or requesting another review.
审批绑定当前差异，数据或权限变化后必须重新申请。: Approval is bound to this diff. Changes to data or permissions require a new request.
对方需要审批权限、每一步操作权限及足够的 AI 风险上限。批准不会自动执行。: The reviewer needs approval permission, permission for each step, and a sufficient AI risk limit. Approval does not execute the plan.
没有符合条件的其他审批人，请联系管理员分配审批权限。: No other eligible reviewers are available. Ask an administrator to assign approval permissions.
说明操作目的和需要核对的内容: Explain the purpose of the action and what should be reviewed
按他人批准的差异执行？: Apply the diff approved by another person?
执行前会再次校验双方权限、风险上限和当前数据。任何变化都会要求重新审批。: Both participants’ permissions, risk limits and current data will be checked again. Any change requires a new approval.
另一位成员核对差异，发起人按批准的版本执行: Another member reviews the diff; the proposer applies the approved version
本人确认与跨人审批可按需选择。跨人审批不会提升任何人的操作权限或 AI 风险上限: Choose self confirmation or another person’s approval as needed. Approval never increases anyone’s permissions or AI risk limit.
原审批已失效，不能继续执行: The original approval is no longer valid
发起人需要重新预演并申请审批；旧差异仅供追溯。: The proposer must preview again and request approval. The previous diff is retained for reference.
审批不存在或当前账号无法访问: The approval does not exist or is inaccessible to this account
确认已核对全部差异？: Confirm that you have reviewed all changes?
批准仅对当前预演版本有效，发起人仍需确认执行。: Approval applies only to this preview version. The proposer still needs to confirm execution.
撤销后计划回到待预演状态，不能使用原批准继续执行。: Revocation returns the plan to the preview stage. The original approval can no longer be used.
请说明需要调整的内容，发起人可以重新申请审批。: Explain what should be changed. The proposer can request approval again.
